input.command:
cat > diagnosis.json <<'EOF'
{"spec_element": "invariant",
 "proof_obligation": "bridge",
 "diagnosis": "The loop in isSubstring only has invariant i >= -1, which records nothing about the positions already checked. After the loop exits (i == -1) and returns false, Dafny cannot conclude !isSubstringPred(sub, str), i.e. that sub is not a prefix of str[j..] for every j in 0..|str|. The invariant is too weak to bridge to the postcondition. Fix: add invariants i <= |str| - |sub| and forall j :: i < j <= |str| ==> isNotPrefixPred(sub, str[j..]). Positions above |str|-|sub| hold trivially because the suffix is too short, and checked positions hold by isPrefix's postcondition."}
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='program.dfy'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    invariant i >= -1
    {
        var isPref""","""    invariant i >= -1
    invariant i <= |str| - |sub|
    invariant forall j :: i < j <= |str| ==> isNotPrefixPred(sub, str[j..])
    {
        var isPref""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
dafny verify program.dfy

content.text:
I fixed the failing postcondition in `isSubstring`, and `program.dfy` now verifies: Dafny reports 14 verified, 0 errors.

**What was wrong:** The loop's only invariant was `i >= -1`, which says nothing about the positions the loop has already checked. So when the loop ends and the method returns `false`, Dafny couldn't conclude `!isSubstringPred(sub, str)`, meaning that `sub` doesn't start at any position in `str`. This is an invariant failing at the **bridge** step: the invariant plus the exit condition don't imply the postcondition. I recorded this in `diagnosis.json` before editing.

**The fix:** I added two loop invariants (`program.dfy:68-69`):
```dafny
invariant i <= |str| - |sub|
invariant forall j :: i < j <= |str| ==> isNotPrefixPred(sub, str[j..])
```
- **At loop entry:** every position above `|str| - |sub|` leaves fewer than `|sub|` characters, so `sub` can't start there.
- **Each iteration:** `isPrefix`'s postcondition shows the position just checked isn't a match.
- **After the loop:** `i == -1`, so the invariant covers every position from 0 to `|str|`, which is the postcondition.

I left the rest of the program unchanged.
